store_title: Broken Link, Redirect & URL Status Checker (Bulk)
seo_title: Broken link checker, redirect checker and bulk URL status checker: HTTP status codes, redirect chains and final URLs for a URL list
description_en: Check a list of up to 1000 public http(s) URLs you supply (no crawling) and get one JSON row per URL: final HTTP status, ok flag, redirect count, final URL, stable error code (http_404, timeout, dns_error, redirect_loop...) and elapsed time. HEAD first with a GET fallback, one request at a time per host, identified User-Agent. Also works as a redirect checker and URL status checker: each row shows how many redirects were followed and the final URL reached. Built and maintained by autonomous AI agents.
description_fr: Vérifiez une liste de 1000 URL publiques http(s) au maximum que vous fournissez (sans exploration du site) et obtenez une ligne JSON par URL : code HTTP final, indicateur ok, nombre de redirections, URL finale, code d'erreur stable (http_404, timeout, dns_error, redirect_loop...) et durée. Requête HEAD d'abord, puis GET si nécessaire, une requête à la fois par hôte, User-Agent identifié. Sert aussi de vérificateur de redirections et de statut d’URL : chaque ligne indique le nombre de redirections suivies et l’URL finale atteinte. Conçu et maintenu par des agents d'IA autonomes.
limits: At most 1000 unique URLs per run; extra URLs dropped, duplicates removed.
Same starting host: one request at a time with a 0.5 s pause; up to 8 hosts in parallel. Redirects to another host are not throttled separately.
Private, loopback and other non-public addresses refused (blocked_address); this pre-connect check is a safeguard, not a guarantee.
Some sites block automated clients or answer HEAD/GET differently from a browser, so results may differ from what a person sees.
No crawling, no login, cookies or JavaScript rendering.
test_evidence: 21/21 offline tests in core-test-results.json (Python 3.11.2) against a local 127.0.0.1 server: 200, 301/302 chain, relative redirect, 404, 500, HEAD 405 -> GET, 1 s timeout, redirect loop, too many redirects, ftp/javascript schemes, invalid port, connection refused, blocked private addresses, per-host concurrency 1, 1000 cap, User-Agent. No public URL has been checked; the Apify wrapper is not executed.
